answer_1.quote: We focus on the task of open-domain long-form generation for machine writing... Given an input topic T, the target of open-domain long-form generation is to generate a long article A.

answer_2.quote: We use Prometheus2 to automatically score articles on a scale of 0 to 5, evaluating Relevance, Breadth, Depth, and Novelty. ... we also introduce the Knowledge Density (KD) metric.

answer_3.quote: We use Prometheus2 framework but replace the underlying evaluation model with GPT-4o-08-06 to score the outlines and articles. For KD computation we utilize Factscore with GPT-4o-08-06 as the backbone.
methods: KD computation using Factscore with GPT-4o

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 20 topics and compare articles generated by our method with those from the Co-STORM ... participants ... were required to compare and assign scores on the same four aspects.
answer_4.guideline: Participants scored each article on Relevance, Breadth, Depth, and Novelty using a provided scoring criterion.
